The process involves multiple steps:

1.  **Country and Capital:** The 2024 Summer Olympics were hosted in Paris, which is the capital city of **France** (Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Summer_Olympics).
2.  **Mayor of the Capital City:** The current mayor of Paris is **Emmanuel Grégoire**, who belongs to the Socialist party (Source: https://apnews.com/article/paris-mayor-emmanuel-gregoire-socialist-b487efda02134f1312c349d1c89bee21).
3.  **Party Leader:** The leader of the French Socialist Party is **Olivier Faure** (Source: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-06-06/french-socialist-faure-reelected-as-party-head-by-narrow-margin).

The party leader of the political party that the current mayor of the capital city of the country that hosted the 2024 Summer Olympics belongs to is **Olivier Faure**.
